questions.stem: Triangle $ABC$ is translated so that $A(2, 5)$ maps to $A'(-1, 8)$. What is the translation vector?
questions.explanation: The translation vector is found by subtracting the original coordinates from the image: $\begin{pmatrix} -1 - 2 \\ 8 - 5 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -3 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}$.

questions.stem: A shape is translated by $\begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix}$ and then by $\begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix}$. What single translation vector has the same effect?
questions.explanation: Two successive translations can be combined by adding the vectors: $\begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 4 \end{pmatrix}$.
